items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Steve Gorn! He played the flutes, soprano and clarinet.

ctx.x: If we could return back to Dancing With Nature Spirits. Steve Gorn?
Steve Gorn! He played the flutes, soprano and clarinet. OK, so we can move on with that. Actually the Oneness group, we actually toured Europe and did some really nice concerts there.
You said that was a short-lived project.
